digest.component_or_area: documentation: CLI help, ticket model, event schema
propositions: Documentation in overview.txt and ticket-model.md incorrectly stated unlink takes no relation argument, contradicting the shipped optional relation-scoped unlink feature in the library and CLI.
Commit 73abb5805f added optional relation selection to unlink but updated only subcommand help and generated docs, omitting the independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md surfaces.
The event-schema.md documentation used pre-change operation wording that did not distinguish the optional relation selector from the emitted UNLINK cancellation by link_uuid.
Both documentation surfaces and event schema must be corrected to document unlink [relation] as optional while preserving the most-recent fallback when relation is omitted.
An explicit canonical relation removes exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair.

The fix updated overview.txt and ticket-model.md to advertise unlink <source> <target> [relation], clarified the omission fallback, and separated operation selection from UUID-targeted UNLINK cancellation in event-schema.md.
